title: Hitorijime My Hero
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: A boys' love romance. Masahiro Setagawa, neglected at home by his mother, falls in with a gang of small-time street bullies until Kousuke Ohshiba, a former street fighter known as 'the bear killer', rescues him; Kousuke later becomes his high-school teacher. Kousuke's brother Kensuke and Kensuke's boyfriend Asaya draw Masahiro into a found family, and a romance develops between the teenage student and his adult teacher, twelve years older (Kodansha USA blurb; ANN volume 1 review; MU).
life_message: A neglected teen finds belonging and a 'hero' in a chosen family.

content.note: Kousuke takes down small-time thugs; not graphic (ANN); gang tags (MU).
Romance between a high-school student and his adult teacher; kissing tame, sex implied not shown (ANN); MU Student-Teacher and Adult-Teenager Relationship. ANN flags power imbalance and thin consent.
